# FoodCheck — Food Intolerance Self-Assessment

> FoodCheck (foodintolerancecheck.com) provides free, browser-based food intolerance self-assessment tools and evidence-based educational content. No data is collected. All tools run client-side.

## Key Pages

- [Food Intolerance Checker](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/) — 3-step symptom assessment exploring possible food intolerances
- [Lactose Intolerance Checker](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/tools/lactose-intolerance-test) — Dairy-specific symptom assessment
- [Gluten Intolerance Checker](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/tools/gluten-intolerance-test) — Gluten sensitivity symptom assessment
- [Histamine Intolerance Checker](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/tools/histamine-intolerance-test) — Histamine reaction assessment
- [Fructose Intolerance Checker](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/tools/fructose-intolerance-test) — Fructose malabsorption assessment
- [Food Diary](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/tools/food-diary) — Meal and symptom tracking tool (localStorage only)
- [Elimination Diet Planner](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/tools/elimination-diet-planner) — Structured elimination diet template
- [Symptoms Overview](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/symptoms) — 8 common food intolerance symptoms

## Guides

- [Intolerance vs Allergy](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/guides/intolerance-vs-allergy) — Key differences in symptoms, mechanisms, and emergency care
- [Testing Guide](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/guides/test-guide) — Comparison of breath tests, IgG tests, and elimination diets
- [Low FODMAP Diet Guide](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/guides/low-fodmap) — Three-phase evidence-based diet protocol
- [Reading Test Results](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/guides/reading-test-results) — Interpreting IgG and breath test reports
- [IBS & Food Intolerance](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/guides/ibs-food-intolerance) — Overlap and management strategies

## Blog

- [Elimination Diet Step-by-Step](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/blog/elimination-diet-guide) — How to conduct a structured elimination diet
- [Low FODMAP Food List](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/blog/low-fodmap-foods) — High and low FODMAP food reference
- [Are Food Intolerance Tests Accurate?](https://foodintolerancecheck.com/blog/are-food-intolerance-tests-accurate) — Evidence review of commercial testing methods

## Content Policy

- All health content is evidence-based and references NHS, BDA, NICE, AAAAI, and Monash University guidelines
- Content is authored by Dr. Emily Carter, Registered Dietitian
- This site provides educational content only — it does not diagnose medical conditions
- No data is collected; all tools run entirely in the browser
